Generated Narrative: CodeSystem nmdp-donor-status

This case-insensitive code system http://fhir.nmdp.org/CodeSystem/donor-status defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
Available AvailableDonor is available for search, further typing, and collection/transplant (ODS code: AV).
Temporarily-Unavailable Temporarily UnavailableDonor is temporarily unavailable, typically post-collection with a future available date (ODS code: TU).
Active ActiveDonor is currently active on a search — reserved for a specific patient case (ODS code: AC).
Permanently-Unavailable Permanently UnavailableDonor has been permanently removed from the registry. Reasons include: not interested, permanently medically deferred, unable to contact, donor too old, or deceased (ODS code: DE).

name: NMDPDonorStatusCS
title: NMDP Donor Status
description:
Status codes for NMDP registered donors. These codes represent the
enterprise Registry Status maintained by NMDP, indicating a donor's availability
for patient search, matching, and product request activities. Source: ODS
DonorWithSampleResponse (v05). In FHIR Donor API payloads, donor status is
conveyed as a valueString on the donor-status extension.
